title: About & Full Album Catalog
text:
This project explores the visual aesthetics and cover art designs of 1,788 albums spanning 8 major music genres (Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop, R&B/Soul, Country, Electronic, Latin, and Jazz).
Every album cover has been computationally analyzed for:

title: About & Full Album Catalog
text:
Complete Catalog (1,788 Albums across 8 Genres)
Use the search bar and column filters below to explore the full dataset, view cover artwork, and inspect extracted color swatches.

title: 1,000 Pop Album Covers: Visual Comparison
text: Understanding and comparing 1,000 album covers at once can be overwhelming. To make comparisons intuitive, every album cover was analyzed along two key visual axes:

title: 1,000 Pop Album Covers: Visual Comparison
